data.title: Ghost Portal Infrastructure Detection — Fake Insurance Verification on Recently Registered Domains
data.description: Detects ghost portal infrastructure — fraudulent insurance verification websites deployed on recently registered domains that return valid-looking but unverifiable policy numbers. Ghost portals represent the evolution of ghost broking into a fraud-as-a-service model, where operators build and sell fake insurance verification platforms to other fraudsters. These portals are typically deployed on domains registered within the past 90 days, use insurance-related keywords, and mimic legitimate insurer verification workflows. Detection focuses on DNS queries and web traffic to recently registered domains containing insurance verification terminology.

queries.cql:
// CQL for Ghost Portal Infrastructure Detection — DL-0189
// Insurance verification portals on recently registered domains
DnsQueries
| query_domain = /insurance.*verify|policy.*check|insurance.*confirm|motor.*verify|cover.*check|insure.*valid/
| query_timestamp >= now() - 7d
| domain_age_days < 90
| groupBy([domain_name, registered_date, registrar, ssl_issuer],
    function=[count() as query_count,
              countDistinct(source_ip) as unique_requestors,
              min(query_timestamp) as first_seen,
              max(query_timestamp) as last_seen])
| query_count >= 10
| sort(query_count, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL: Ghost Portal Infrastructure Detection")`
`comment("Insurance verification portals on recently registered domains")`
index=flame_web sourcetype=flame:dns_proxy
  (query="*insurance*verify*" OR query="*policy*check*" OR query="*insurance*confirm*"
   OR query="*motor*verify*" OR query="*cover*check*" OR query="*insure*valid*")
| lookup domain_age_lookup domain AS query OUTPUT domain_registered_date
| eval domain_age_days = round((now() - strptime(domain_registered_date, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400)
| where domain_age_days < 90
| stats count AS query_count, dc(src_ip) AS unique_requestors,
        values(query) AS domains, min(_time) AS first_seen, max(_time) AS last_seen
  BY domain_registered_date
| where query_count >= 10
| eval days_active = round((last_seen - first_seen) / 86400, 1)
| sort - query_count
queries.sql:
-- SQL: Ghost Portal Infrastructure Detection
-- Recently registered domains mimicking insurance verification portals
SELECT
  d.domain_name,
  d.registered_date,
  DATEDIFF(DAY, d.registered_date, CURRENT_DATE) AS domain_age_days,
  d.registrar,
  COUNT(*) AS query_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT q.source_ip) AS unique_requestors,
  MIN(q.query_timestamp) AS first_seen,
  MAX(q.query_timestamp) AS last_seen,
  d.ssl_issuer
FROM dns_queries q
JOIN domain_registry d ON q.query_domain = d.domain_name
WHERE (q.query_domain LIKE '%insurance%verify%'
  OR q.query_domain LIKE '%policy%check%'
  OR q.query_domain LIKE '%insurance%confirm%'
  OR q.query_domain LIKE '%motor%verify%'
  OR q.query_domain LIKE '%cover%check%'
  OR q.query_domain LIKE '%insure%valid%')
  AND DATEDIFF(DAY, d.registered_date, CURRENT_DATE) < 90
  AND q.query_timestamp >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY d.domain_name, d.registered_date, d.registrar, d.ssl_issuer
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY query_count DESC

references: Insurance Times, Ghost portals: the next evolution in insurance fraud (2025)
falsepositives: Newly launched legitimate insurance comparison or verification services
Insurance technology startups with recently registered domains
Internal testing of insurance verification APIs on new domains
